_comment: Which pets belong to which SKILL, for a skill-of-the-week's highlight feed. BOSS pets are NOT listed here and must not be: a pet sits on its boss's own collection-log page, so a boss-of-the-week finds its own pet with no map at all (lib/moments.ts). Skilling pets have no such page — the log files them under 'All Pets' and nowhere else — which is the entire reason this file exists. Names are matched case-insensitively against src/data/clog.json and a test fails the build if one stops matching, so a dataset rebuild that renames a pet can't silently empty a skill. Slayer lists the pets of monsters you get ASSIGNED, which is what a Slayer week is actually about. Add to it freely: an unknown name is inert, not an error.
